reason: CIBDI (Musée de la bande dessinée, Angoulême) publishes its catalogue on alienor.org — the official collections-management/publication platform of the Réseau des musées de Nouvelle-Aquitaine (ex-Poitou-Charentes), linked directly from citebd.org/les-collections-… This is the museum's own designated database (a public-institution consortium tool, NOT a content aggregator like Europeana), analogous to billy-ireland=OSU library and korea-manhwa=KOMACON. It exposes a Solr-backed JSON search API on alienor's own infra: GET https://www.alienor.org/search/results?advancedSearch=1&museums=M0820&page=N (X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest) → {results[], nbResults, last}. museums=M0820 isolates the BD museum: 4,871 catalogued works, all metadata present in the listing JSON (title, author, denomination, technical, material, formDimensions, exeDate, inventoryNumber, description, image). Images are served openly on alienor's media host (/media/synchro/{sid}/image1000.jpeg), no login/watermark; ~80% of records carry a real image and ~68% of those are ≥600px (long-side up to ~1140px). Probe collected 17 in-scope original comic boards end-to-end with 100% of the 4 required fields, real ≥600px unwatermarked images uploaded to R2, and a downloaded sample visually confirmed as a genuine hand-inked planche originale (Calvo, Patamousse).
easy_source_found: No opendata/IIIF/Drupal-jsonapi on citebd.org itself (Drupal site, /core/ disallowed in robots, no per-object catalogue). The collection lives on the consortium platform alienor.org (Réseau des musées de Nouvelle-Aquitaine), which has a Solr JSON search API proxied at /search/results (the front-end /recherche page calls it via AJAX). Filter museums=M0820 = Musée de la bande dessinée d'Angoulême. This is the museum's own publication channel, not a third-party aggregator. citebd.org also points users to alienor.org and Gallica/BnF, but Gallica is an aggregator (forbidden) — alienor is the museum's own catalogue.
probe_summary: node scripts/scrape-cibdi-angouleme.mjs --probe collected 17 in-scope original comic boards (all category=drawing) end-to-end. 4-required fill 17/17 (title/artist/year/category=100%); 6-standard: medium 17/17, dimensions 14/17. All imageUrl on R2, unique; 17/17 R2 images load via curl GET (urllib 403s are a UA quirk of the R2 dev endpoint, browsers/weserv work). Downloaded R2 image cibdi-angouleme-72436 = 804x1140 webp, visually confirmed a real hand-inked Calvo 'Patamousse' board (no watermark, clean margins). Size gate skipped 10 old 360px-thumb candidates; 0 image errors; 0 min-4 drops. Output: public/data/cibdi-angouleme-collection-probe.json.

exhibitions_entry.name: Cité internationale de la bande dessinée et de l'image
exhibitions_entry.description: Europe's foremost museum of comic art, set in restored 19th-century riverside warehouses on the Charente. Its collection holds more than 25,000 original comic boards (planches originales) tracing the ninth art from its Franco-Belgian cradle to American comics and Asian manga; the digitised catalogue serves thousands of original drawings by masters such as Franquin, Calvo, Quino, Cosey and Saint-Ogan.
exhibitions_entry.description_ko: 샤랑트 강변의 19세기 양조 창고를 개조해 들어선, 유럽을 대표하는 만화 미술관이다. 프랑코-벨기에 만화부터 미국 코믹스, 아시아 망가까지 '제9의 예술' 전반을 아우르며 25,000점이 넘는 만화 원화(planche originale)를 소장한다. 프랑캥, 칼보, 키노, 코제, 생-토강 같은 거장들의 손으로 그린 원화 수천 점을 온라인 카탈로그에서 만날 수 있다.

notes: Catalogue host = alienor.org (museum's own consortium platform; NOT Europeana/Wikidata/Gallica). API: /search/results?advancedSearch=1&museums=M0820&page=N (1..116, 42/page), JSON with full per-record metadata — no per-object detail fetch needed. Image: listing `image` field /media/synchro/{sid}/image250.jpeg → swap to image1000.jpeg for the largest tier (only one large size served; long-side ≤~1140px). Object page sourceUrl = /collections/oeuvre/{id} (numeric id only; slug optional). Counts: total 4,871; with-image 3,912; in-scope 4,505; in-scope+image 3,613 (drawing 3,303, print 297, mixed_media_2d 13); excluded 366 (pure imprimé/coupure-de-presse reproductions + a few 3D). ≥600px ratio measured 68% on a 60-record random sample → est ~2,450 collectible. KEY GOTCHA: ~32% of imaged records are old 360x360 thumbnail digitisations (the only image1000 served is upscaled-capped at the original scan size); the scraper's sharp size gate (<600px → skip) drops these — this is why --full collects ~2,450 not 3,613. Newest acquisitions (2025.x, page 1-2) are catalogued but not yet digitised (no image) — also skipped. Scope: original flat art kept as drawing/mixed_media_2d; comic posters/prints (affiche/sérigraphie/épreuve/tirage) kept as print; printed book/magazine reproductions (imprimé, coupure de presse) and 3D excluded. ids prefixed cibdi-angouleme-; R2 key artworks/cibdi-angouleme-collection/{id}-{hash8}-imageUrl.webp. --full is resumable (scripts/.state/cibdi-angouleme-progress.json, failures→cibdi-angouleme-failed.ndjson). DID NOT run --full per instructions. Estimated --full JSON well under 24MB cap (~2,450 records × ~1KB metadata ≈ 2.5MB).
